imagens.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE luxury commercial jewelry product photograph, variation MJ-03 V1. Image 1 is the exact jewelry edit target; image 2 is supporting detail reference of the SAME pair. Preserve the exact objects, all structural geometry, proportions, small link topology, attachment points and gemstone setting design. Replace the fabric/environment ONLY with pristine infinite solid pure white #FFFFFF, textureless and horizonless. Present the complete pair centered, upright side by side, balanced front view matching the reference, generous white margins. Each earring has exactly three nested pointed arch/chevron metal components connected at their peaks, exactly three fine round-link U shaped chain swags of differing lengths attached to arch tips, and the original small elongated central clear-stone cluster hanging inside. Retain actual reference metal colors including pale metallic reflected faces and yellow-gold chains/edges. Do not replace with a different earring, do not add stones, do not change cluster configuration, do not thicken chains, do not simplify links. Jewelry itself must be meticulously copied from references. Tiffany & Co. caliber editorial lighting only, no branding. Large diffused softbox lighting, immaculate controlled metallic reflections, realistic delicate gemstone dispersion, no artificial starbursts, ultra sharp 100mm macro lens focus throughout jewelry. No harsh or heavy shadows; virtually imperceptible soft contact shadow only. Hyper-detailed extreme photorealism, pristine metal, highest available native resolution, 8K visual detail aesthetic. Portrait 3:4 composition. No fabric, props, pedestal, people, text, logos, watermarks, gradients, beige or gray background. Output ONE standalone photo, no collage.

Do not mirror or redesign them or make them perfectly identical. Replace ONLY fabric with flat infinite #FFFFFF pure white textureless background, keeping every small jewelry shape and proportion intact. THREE thin pointed nested metal arches per earring with original small articulated apex joints, THREE fine gold round-link U loops per earring, one small elongated cluster of clear stones hanging centrally; exact stone sizes/arrangement from references. Retain original delicate chain thickness and original arch length-to-width ratios; no enlargement of gemstones, no additional prongs, no invented details or backside. Editorial composition tighter than a catalog overview, pair occupies ~85% portrait 3:4 frame but every chain remains inside frame. Tiffany & Co. level commercial studio quality, zero logos or added branding. 100mm macro lens, subtle directional broad softbox from upper right and gentle fill for pristine metal reflections, immaculate but realistic gemstones, all jewelry sharply focused. White field absolutely uniform RGB255,255,255 no vignette or gradient, no texture or fabric grain, no pedestal, props, typography, hands, stand or harsh shadow. Extreme photorealism, highest native resolution, 8K aesthetic detail. Priority is fidelity to exact existing jewelry over stylization. ONE image no collage.
